description: Manage Simulink Variant Manager and Variant Configurations workflows — examine, list, and explore variant configurations, variant control variables, and variant model structure; create, modify, and delete variant configurations; validate variant constraints; generate valid variant configurations; apply, activate, or update models with variant configurations; compare variant configurations and analyze which blocks are active or different; open or close the Variant Manager UI; set up non-intrusive variant configuration specific simulation and testing with variant configurations; show/hide variant control variable usage. Use when working with variant configurations, variant manager, VCS objects (VariantConfigurationData / VariantConfigurations), variant control variables, preferred configuration, activation of variant choices, or reducing a variant model to selected variant configurations.
